output.action: He leaves the shed and walks to the hardware store to buy a new handsaw, skipping his usual coffee so he can still repair the bridge step before the 9 a.m. call.
output.explanation: The missing handsaw and the memory of forcing the bent hacksaw through a rusted shackle make him distrust the hacksaw for a clean cut. His careful checking of finished work and his history of skipping coffee on tight Fridays lead him to buy the right tool despite the schedule.
